Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental logical error in the first step by misinterpreting the question. The question asks "Which **film** has the director who is older," implying a comparison between the director of the film "One Down, Two To Go" and the person named "Andrei Svislotskiy" (who is likely the director of another film). The Planner incorrectly treated "Andrei Svislotskiy" as if it were the *name of a film* in the comparison ("Which film has the director who is older than the other, [Film A] or [Film B]?"). Consequently, the Planner proceeded to compare the birth years of two directors (Fred Williamson and Andrei Svislotskiy) instead of comparing the birth years of a director and a film (which is nonsensical) or, more likely, failing to realize the question was a trick or comparing the director of "One Down, Two To Go" to the director of the film *directed by* Andrei Svislotskiy. The core mistake is the flawed understanding of the entities being compared in the very first analysis step.
